info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to commission agreement details by utilizing a specified parameter. It enables users to retrieve information related to sales commissions, streamlining the process of reviewing or validating agreements. Typical consumers of this API include sales teams and financial analysts who need to confirm commission structures for specific transactions. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can ensure accurate commission calculations and improve operational transparency.

get.description: Fetch the commission agreement details for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to access comprehensive data related to the sales commission agreements, including terms and conditions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the commission agreement details for the provided resource ID. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request for valid responses.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the commission agreement details.
